page.overview:
Who is Chang Kritch?

Chang Kritch was an assassin of Clan Eshin and a triad-brother of Chang Fang and Chang Squik. Little is known about him, other than the fact that following the disgrace of his brother Chang Squik, him and his surviving brother were expunged from the order of assassins. No one would hire a failure, and in utter shame, Chang Kritch opened his belly in ritual suicide. His brother, Chang Fang, was a bit more determined however.
